selected_bottleneck: run-changeset-ledger-item-integrity（运行变更集账本条目完整性）
selected_problem: Fresh canonical main publishes North Star Run v0.2 with changesets.items constrained to strings, but RunStore.get and RunStore.update only checked that changesets was an array. Durable or write-side object entries could therefore violate the checked-in contract and later flow into changeset lookup paths.（最新规范主仓已经在 North Star Run v0.2 契约中把 changesets.items 约束为字符串，但 RunStore.get 和 RunStore.update 只检查 changesets 是否为数组，因此持久化或写入侧的对象条目仍可违反仓库内正式契约，并继续流入后续变更集查找路径。）
selection_basis: The checked-in schema already defines changesets item type as string; this cycle enforces an existing contract rather than introducing a new ledger policy.（仓库内 schema 已经明确 changesets 条目类型为字符串；本轮只是执行既有契约，没有引入新的账本政策。）

NorthStarRunner appends ChangesetStore ids as strings and later consumes the last changeset id as a store key, so non-string entries contradict the real execution path.（NorthStarRunner 实际追加的是 ChangesetStore 字符串 ID，并把最后一个 changeset ID 当作存储键消费，因此非字符串条目与真实执行路径直接矛盾。）

pre_fix_reality.focused_test: 1/3 PASS, 2/3 FAIL（1/3 通过，2/3 失败）
failures: A durable changesets entry rewritten to an object was accepted by RunStore.get.（持久化 changesets 条目被改写为对象后仍被 RunStore.get 接受。）
RunStore.update accepted an array containing a non-string changeset entry.（RunStore.update 接受了包含非字符串变更集条目的数组。）

changes: Add one shared changeset-ledger predicate matching the published schema item type.（新增一个与已发布 schema 条目类型一致的共享变更集账本判定器。）
Fail closed on non-string changeset entries at both durable read and update boundaries.（在持久化读取边界与更新边界同时对非字符串变更集条目失败关闭。）
Preserve ordinary string changeset ids unchanged.（保持正常字符串 changeset ID 的既有行为不变。）

verification.node_check: PASS on exact proposed core/run-store.mjs（精确拟议 core/run-store.mjs 的 Node 语法检查通过）
verification.focused_test: 3/3 PASS, 0 skipped（3/3 通过，0 跳过）

truth_boundary: This cycle validates the item type of the changesets ledger only. It does not define append-only semantics, authenticate the full run artifact, or choose a broader audit/trust architecture.（本轮只验证 changesets 账本条目类型；不定义只追加语义，不认证整个 run 工件，也不选择更广义的审计/信任架构。）
